_readme: Банк УТВЕРЖДЁННЫХ визуальных стилей владельца — каталог для art_director.py (см. docs/ARCHITECTURE или комментарий в art_director.py про STYLE_BANK). Каждый стиль — выжимка ЛУЧШЕГО рецепта этого стиля из docs/*_RECIPES.json/*_STYLES*.json/JJK_TEN.json. essence/text_treatment — на английском (вшиваются в промпт художника), остальные поля — служебные (ротация/подбор по теме). Стили можно миксовать (style_mix) по правилу владельца, см. mixing.allowed ниже. Стиль id='09_ring_medallion' — ГИБРИД: кольцевой текст рисует КОД (typography/typography_v3), в САМ художественный промпт кольцо ВСТАВЛЯЕТСЯ ПУСТЫМ (без слов) — см. hybrid_ring_text=true и art_director._style_bank_prompt_block().

mixing.rule: Владелец разрешает миксовать до 2 стилей на один дизайн (style_mix), когда тема реально просит совмещения (например geometry ар-деко + японская гравюра). Claude сам решает через поле style_mix в JSON-ответе — см. art_director.py.

styles.essence: The figure is fully framed by an ornamental baroque border of thin gilded scrollwork and flame/floral motifs running along the edge of the frame, engraved like a metal plate — rich blackletter-meets-antiqua display lettering in glossy metallic gold sits above the figure's head, following the curvature of the frame's top edge, never overlapping the figure. Deep saturated jewel-tone palette (blood red, antique gold, aged bronze, near-black charcoal) with heavy engraved shading.
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase in ornate blackletter/antiqua display face, glossy metallic gold gradient fill with thin engraved bronze outline and soft dark drop shadow, arced along the top frame edge above the head. Vertical kanji/katakana column (if character has a name) placed fully inside the frame margin, outside the figure's silhouette, matching gold treatment.
styles.palette_rule: Deep jewel tones: blood red / antique gold / aged bronze / near-black charcoal — text always gold, never a flat basic color.
constraints: рамка-вставка ДЕКОРАТИВНАЯ, не должна упираться в край кадра — оставляй широкие хромакей-поля СНАРУЖИ орнамента

styles.essence: The figure stands centered in a static frontal or three-quarter pose, fully enclosed by a thin decorative circular medallion ring/border (like a coin or guild crest) running at an even radial distance around the whole figure — classic emblem/badge composition, clean anime cel-shading figure inside, ornamental notches or small emblem glyphs marking the ring's seam at the top.
styles.text_treatment: hybrid_ring_text: the decorative ring itself is drawn EMPTY in the image generation — no letters anywhere on the ring in the art prompt. The ring TEXT (character name / phrase running along the circumference) is added AFTERWARD by CODE (typography.py / typography_v3.py ring-text renderer), never by the image model. The art prompt must explicitly describe the ring as a plain metal/enamel band with only ornamental notches, NOT request any lettering on it.
styles.palette_rule: Aged gold ring + matte black or deep color figure fill + one accent color for a small emblem glyph at the ring seam.
constraints: в художественном промпте кольцо ЯВНО описывается как ПУСТОЕ (без текста) — иначе модель дублирует текст, который потом накладывает код

styles.essence: Heroic socialist-realism poster pose: figure stands wide-legged on a pedestal/rubble, one arm raised overhead in a clenched fist, the other doing a signature gesture, behind them a large graphic disc of a rising sun with sharp straight sunburst rays and a bold flat silhouette motif (animal/summon/symbol of the character) inside the disc. Flat saturated poster inks, no gradients, light print-grain texture and slight colour-plate misregistration like old lithography, dramatic low-angle shot.
styles.text_treatment: Main slogan in a heavy geometric propaganda-poster slab face, flat fill with a thin contrasting keyline, set in a straight horizontal band across the upper third in front of the sun rays. Secondary line in a smaller matching slab weight stacked below. Vertical kanji/katakana name column in the lower margin beside the leg, stamp-style.
styles.palette_rule: Warm poster duotone (burnt orange/crimson/cream) OR cold inverted variant (black/crimson) depending on character tone — always flat, no gradients except rain/mist hatching if thematically justified.
constraints: текст ВСЕГДА на топслое поверх лучей, лучи видны только вокруг букв

styles.essence: The static wide-legged pedestal pose is replaced by a hard diagonal dynamic composition (15-20 degree tilt): figure frozen mid-lunge/mid-punch along the diagonal axis, aura/hair/effects swept along the same diagonal, the sun-disc pushed off-center into a corner, partially cropped, rays radiating at the same diagonal tilt. Constructivist Rodchenko/Klutsis energy crossed with the propaganda-poster base.
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase built as stepped/cascading diagonal text-plates (one word per plate) tilted at the same angle as the figure's dash, OR a single bold diagonal wordmark running parallel to the main colour band. Vertical name column kept perfectly UPRIGHT (not tilted) as a stable anchor.
styles.palette_rule: Same propaganda duotone base, with the diagonal bands themselves as a strong flat colour block (e.g. cobalt blue / golden-yellow).
constraints: весь текст и фон наклонены на ЕДИНЫЙ угол 15-20 градусов, кроме вертикальной колонки имени

styles.essence: Figure marches straight toward the viewer along the exact center axis, striding hard so a boot appears to break the bottom frame edge. Instead of a full sun-disc, only the upper HALF of a large sun sits low at a horizon line, bisected by silhouetted rooftops/rubble; sunburst rays fan out filling the whole upper background, converging low behind the striding legs — a 'marching crowd toward camera' feeling.
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase set in a wide gentle ARC following the curved upper edge of the canvas (arched banner, each letter tangent to the arc), peaking above the figure's head. Secondary line sits as a straight horizontal band along the horizon/bisecting edge, separated from the main line. Vertical name column mirrored to balance the arc.
styles.palette_rule: Warm advancing tones (blood-orange, golden-yellow, cream, charcoal) — horizon line always reads as a hard edge between rays above and dark silhouette below.
constraints: ровно ОДНА арка текста сверху + ОДНА горизонтальная строка на линии горизонта — не дублировать фразу

styles.essence: Classic Japanese woodblock print (mokuhanga, Hokusai/Kuniyoshi school): flat poster-ink layers with visible wood-grain texture running through every large colour field, thick carved black contour line, stylised claw-like wave/cloud curls, slight colour-plate offset misregistration mimicking hand-printing. A monumental Hokusai-style wave often curls above the figure without ever overlapping the face. Small round vermilion hanko seal cartouches sit in the upper corners.
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase inside a long horizontal woodblock-printed title cartouche (ruled panel, aged-parchment cream fill, thick carved black double-rule border), phrase in a bold hand-carved brush-caps face, sumi-ink black fill. Name column as a traditional red hanko-stamp vertical cartouche beside the trailing leg/hem.
styles.palette_rule: Indigo blue, sumi-ink black, vermilion red, aged parchment cream + one character-specific accent (steel-grey blades, sage-green bamboo etc.) — check chroma_note for green-heavy characters (use blue chroma).
constraints: SINGLE FIGURE, one clear three-quarter view only

styles.essence: Gothic church stained-glass window fills the entire canvas: thick black lead-came outline traces every colour segment exactly like real leaded glass, flat saturated semi-transparent segment fills as if lit from behind, no soft shading. Figure stands centered beneath a pointed gothic arch with a small tracery rose-medallion above the head; often a light/dark duality splits the background down the vertical centerline (cool half vs warm half).
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase set inside a narrow horizontal leaded-glass banner-segment spanning the arch width, same thick black lead-came border, phrase in a tall gothic blackletter display face, luminous glass-colour fill with black lead outline around every letter. Name column as a small leaded glass panel in the lower margin, same lead-outline treatment.
styles.palette_rule: Deep saturated glass jewel-tones (cobalt/emerald/crimson/amber/gold) split light/dark across the centerline — WATCH for emerald-green glass segments, usually forces chroma=blue.
constraints: SINGLE FIGURE, one clear frontal view only

styles.essence: Strictly mirror-symmetrical Gatsby/Chrysler-Building composition: tall geometric golden sunburst fan-rays radiate from directly behind the figure's head/shoulders filling the whole upper background (stepped rays alternating bright gold and deep bronze), a thin elegant rectangular deco frame-line with stepped corner ornaments borders the canvas edge. Figure poised, elegant, centered.
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase inside a slim horizontal rectangular gold plaque beneath the figure, flat deep-bronze fill with a thin bright-gold stepped deco border and matching stepped corner motifs, phrase in an elegant thin geometric deco capitals face with wide letter-tracking, solid bright metallic gold fill. Name column as a gold stamp-style vertical column beside the deco frame-line.
styles.palette_rule: Bright metallic gold + deep bronze + one dark base colour (matte black/deep colour garment) + cream ivory field — no additional loud accents, luxury restraint.
constraints: строгая зеркальная симметрия по вертикальной оси — обязательна

styles.essence: Tall rectangular tarot-arcana card frame fills the canvas: a thick ornate engraved border of interlocking vine-and-star (or baroque acanthus-gold, if mixed) filigree runs around all four edges, small mystical star/crescent-moon/infinity glyphs mark the four corners outside the silhouette, a star-dusted deep-indigo sky with a single large pale moon glows behind the figure without overlapping the face. Calm, composed, mystical but NOT dark/gothic — restrained occult elegance.
styles.text_treatment: Main arcana-name phrase set inside a narrow horizontal engraved title plaque directly below the frame's top border (traditional arcana-name position), aged parchment-cream plaque with a thin double-rule engraved border, phrase in an elegant engraved serif display face with small terminal flourishes, deep indigo-black fill. A small roman-numeral arcana-number plaque sits below the card's bottom border, pale gold fill. Name column as a fine engraved gold vertical column in the lower margin.
styles.palette_rule: Deep indigo night-blue, ivory white, pale gold filigree, soft lavender-grey shading, parchment cream plaque — calm mystic, never blood/gore tones.

styles.essence: Formal heraldic shield fills the canvas: the shield is divided into four quarters by a thin engraved cross-line, two opposing quarters in one flat colour field, the other two in a contrasting flat field (classic heraldic quartering). A pair of symmetrical ornaments (laurel branches, OR crossed ceremonial polearms/weapons for a more martial variant) curve along the outer edges meeting near the bottom point, a five-pointed star sits centered above the shield's top edge, a ribbon-scroll banner sweeps beneath the shield's bottom point.
styles.text_treatment: Main motto phrase set on the ribbon-scroll banner beneath the shield's point, flat colour fill with a thin metallic (gold or silver) double-rule border, phrase in a bold engraved heraldic serif face with subtle small-caps flourish, solid metallic fill. Name column as a metallic engraved vertical column beside the trailing leg, outside the shield.
styles.palette_rule: Two contrasting heraldic quarter-colours (e.g. deep crimson + cream, or crimson + charcoal-navy) + one metallic trim (pale gold or silver) — restrained, no more than 3 flat colours plus metallic.
constraints: ровно 4 геральдические четверти щита с чёткой границей

styles.essence: Chunky 16-bit pixel-art sprite occupying only ~55% of frame height (reduced scale to leave room for UI chrome), rendered entirely in large visible square pixel blocks with a limited retro colour count and hard stair-step edges on every diagonal, simple idle/taunt pose. Above the sprite a thin pixel-bordered HP-bar (or two, for a versus-screen variant) spans the top edge; below the sprite a rectangular pixel-bordered dialogue box with a small triangular pointer anchors the bottom edge.
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase set INSIDE the bottom-anchored pixel dialogue box, flat white fill with a hard black double-pixel outline, phrase in a blocky monospace pixel-font face, solid black fill. Optional score/HP readout in the upper corner in the same pixel-font style. Name column as a pixel-font vertical column beside the HP-bar, outside the sprite.
styles.palette_rule: Limited retro palette matching the character's canon colours in flat blocks — avoid gradients entirely, hard pixel edges only. Watch for a canonically green HP-bar/UI element forcing chroma=blue.
constraints: фигура-спрайт ~55% высоты кадра (НЕ обычные 75-80%) — место под UI обязательно

styles.essence: A large flat-colour diamond road-warning sign (safety-yellow enamel) fills most of the canvas, a bold black stencil-cut icon graphic (matching the character's signature weapon/power) sits printed flat behind the silhouette within the diamond, the enamel surface carries visible scratched/chipped metal texture and bolt-holes at the four corners. A handful of small flat sticker-bomb graphics (simple shapes, no extra readable words) are scattered loosely around the outside edge of the diamond.
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase on a bold horizontal stencil-cut warning banner beneath the figure, matte-black stencil plate fill with scratched-metal texture, phrase in a heavy industrial stencil face, solid safety-yellow fill matching the enamel. Optional secondary phrase on a small separate sticker-bomb tag outside the diamond. Name column as a matte-black stencil vertical column beside the figure, outside the silhouette.
styles.palette_rule: Safety-yellow enamel + matte black stencil + one small safety-orange sticker accent — bold industrial contrast, no soft tones.
constraints: SINGLE FIGURE, one clear frontal three-quarter view only

styles.essence: Aggressive metal-album cover composition filling the canvas: jagged lightning-bolt graphic streaks radiate outward from behind the figure's shoulders/weapon but stop well INSET from the frame corners (never touching them), sharp thorned-spike ornament shapes frame the lower edge beneath the feet while staying INSET from the very bottom border, flat stormy charcoal-black background with faint distant lightning-flash streaks, a thin engraved metallic border sits INSET a clear margin away from the true canvas edge (not touching it) — a flat, undecorated chroma-key strip must remain visible all around the outer edge of the canvas, outside this metallic border.
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase (band/title-style) as a huge aggressive metal-band display lettering block spanning the canvas width beneath the figure, letterforms built from sharp angular strokes with small thorn-spike/lightning-crack details on the stroke edges while staying fully legible, solid gunmetal-silver fill with a thin coloured bevel edge. Optional smaller subtitle line beneath. Name column as a gunmetal-silver vertical column beside the shoulder/weapon.
styles.palette_rule: Matte black + gunmetal silver + ONE accent colour (crimson or steel-blue) — no glowing runes/occult symbols unless the theme explicitly calls for it (safety: keep it heroic, not demonic).
constraints: SINGLE FIGURE, one clear frontal three-quarter view only

styles.essence: Reproduce the viral internet meme in its INSTANTLY RECOGNISABLE original form — the exact character/creature/image and composition that actually went viral, faithful to the source picture everyone has already seen. This is a RECOGNITION-first style, not an art-direction style: keep the original colours, the original pose and expression, and crucially the original drawing simplicity — if the meme is deliberately crude, low-effort, MS-Paint, childlike or lo-fi, PRESERVE that crudeness exactly (do NOT 'upgrade' it into polished art, that kills the recognition). The meme subject is large and centered, filling most of the frame, on a clean flat chroma-key background with nothing else competing. The goal is that an ANICLOT customer who saw the meme on TikTok/VK recognises it in under one second. If the meme has a canonical caption/phrase, reproduce it faithfully; if the meme is silent, leave it clean.
styles.text_treatment: If the meme has a well-known canonical caption, reproduce it as-is in a plain readable font close to how it appears in the original (top-and-bottom impact-caption layout for classic image-macro memes, or the meme's own lettering if it has a signature look). If the original has no text, leave it textless OR add one short punchy caption in a clean neutral font at the bottom — never wrap the meme in ornate decorative typography, that fights the recognition. Keep any text large and legible for print.
styles.palette_rule: Use the meme's ACTUAL original colours — do not recolour, do not restyle the palette. Faithfulness to the source over aesthetic harmony.
constraints: SINGLE SUBJECT, узнаваемость оригинала ВАЖНЕЕ художественности — не добавляй рамки/орнаменты/декор чужих стилей вокруг мема
сохраняй нарочитую простоту/кривизну оригинала если она часть мема (не облагораживать)
субъект крупно по центру, чистый хромакей по всем краям
если у мема есть каноничный вид — держись его, а не общей 'красивой' интерпретации
для аниме-мемов — обязателен референс персонажа (character_ref), для интернет-мемов — точное каноничное описание оригинала в теме

styles.essence: The whole print is rendered as a Byzantine gold-ground wall mosaic / icon: the entire image — figure and background — is assembled from countless small square glass tesserae with visible grout seams and a thin dark contour tracing each shape, every colour field tiled in flat mosaic blocks with no soft shading and no perspective. A solid shimmering GOLD smalti ground fills the whole background in staggered brick-laid golden squares catching light unevenly, with a large circular gold halo of radiating tesserae set behind the figure's head. The figure stands frontal and hieratic like an icon saint, calm and solemn. A rectangular decorative frame of interlocking geometric mosaic bands (a running guilloche of two contrasting tesserae between thin fillets) borders the composition.
styles.text_treatment: Main phrase set exactly once in a solemn wide Roman-capital form, the letters themselves built from small dark-red and deep-blue tesserae with a thin gold-grout outline so the lettering reads as inlaid mosaic, placed as a single horizontal line in the lower gold field above the bottom mosaic border. Vertical kanji/katakana name column tiled from pale silver-white tesserae against the gold ground, placed outside the figure's silhouette in the inner frame field.
styles.palette_rule: Shimmering gold ground + pearl silver-white + charcoal black + cream ivory + two accent tesserae colours (deep lapis blue / dark red) for lettering and borders. Gold always dominates.
constraints: SINGLE FIGURE, строго фронтальный иконный вид

styles.essence: A retro pop-art comic panel in the Lichtenstein manner: the figure is drawn as a dramatic bust or half-figure with thick bold black ink outlines and flat bright primary colours, modelled with visible Ben-Day halftone dots. The panel background is a flat saturated field broken by a regular halftone dot-screen (classic comic colour). A rectangular caption box sits in one upper corner carrying one short scene-setting line, and a speech bubble with a tail carries one short line of dialogue. A bold comic-panel border frames the composition.
styles.text_treatment: Dialogue set exactly once inside a white speech bubble with a thick black outline and a tail pointing at the figure, in a bold comic hand-lettered caps face, solid black fill. A short caption line sits once in a small rectangular caption box (flat colour with a thin border) in an upper corner. Vertical kanji/katakana name column as a small vertical tag near a lower corner, outside the figure. Keep both texts short and real (not imitation) so they read cleanly.
styles.palette_rule: Flat bright comic primaries (yellow / red / blue) + thick black ink + white bubble; Ben-Day halftone dots in one accent colour over the background field.
constraints: толстый чёрный контур + бен-дэй точки обязательны
ровно ОДИН речевой пузырь + ОДНА caption-плашка, обе с коротким реальным текстом

styles.essence: An energetic silk-screen concert gig-poster / tour poster: the figure is the poster hero, drawn in bold graphic screenprint style with thick outlines, set against a burst of radiating sunburst rays and scattered sparkle-stars in a limited punchy palette with light halftone grain. A big bold band-name wordmark lockup dominates the top, a smaller event / 'WORLD TOUR' line sits in a banner-bar beneath it, and a small decorative tour-date list or barcode strip anchors a bottom corner as fine print.
styles.text_treatment: Band-name wordmark set exactly once, large and bold across the top in a heavy poster display face (arched or slab), one flat fill with a thin keyline. Secondary event line ('WORLD TOUR' etc.) set once in a filled banner-bar directly beneath it. Vertical kanji/katakana name as a small vertical tag in a lower corner. The bottom tour-date list / barcode is DECORATIVE fine print — thin placeholder strokes suggesting text, never real readable words.
styles.palette_rule: Two-to-three punchy screenprint spot colours (hot pink / golden-yellow / teal) + black outlines + cream, high energy, visible halftone grain.
constraints: SINGLE FIGURE как постерный герой + лучи/звёзды позади
главный band-name крупно сверху + event-строка — читаемые; даты/мелочь внизу — декоративная имитация без реальных слов

styles.essence: A collegiate athletic varsity print where the TYPOGRAPHY is the hero, not a full illustration: a GIANT central number dominates the composition (bold collegiate block numerals with a felt-patch / twill-applique look — layered outline and drop-stitch edge), the character's name set in an arched collegiate wordmark above it, and a small round crest-patch emblem of the character (head plus signature prop) placed between the name and the number. A few small star or accent marks are scattered around. The figure appears only minimal / emblematic inside the crest-patch — the athletic lettering and number carry the print.
styles.text_treatment: Character name set exactly once as an arched collegiate block wordmark across the top (varsity serif/block face, layered twill-patch fill with an outline). The giant number is centered below in the same twill-patch treatment as the single largest element. Vertical kanji/katakana name as a small vertical accent beside the number. A small arched 'athletic tagline' at the very bottom is DECORATIVE fine print, not real words.
styles.palette_rule: Two-tone collegiate athletic palette (cream + one strong team colour) + gold or black outline trim, felt-patch texture; flat, no gradients.
constraints: ГИГАНТСКИЙ номер + имя дугой = главные элементы (типографика-герой), фигура — минимальная эмблема-патч

styles.essence: A premium bootleg anime magazine-inspired WEARABLE DIE-CUT PRINT / weeb streetwear zine layout in a STRICT VERTICAL 2:3 canvas — NOT A RECTANGULAR magazine cover, poster, card or full-bleed page. ALL elements float on a clean flat chroma-key background with a clearly visible 6-8% CHROMA MOAT to every canvas edge (NO filled paper rectangle or box behind them — the print sits directly on the bare garment fabric). NEVER unify the character, typography and effects with a solid white, cream, beige or paper-coloured sticker backing: light colours are allowed only locally in hair, clothes, letters and thin keylines; the gaps between separate elements remain bare chroma. A single canon-accurate anime character is the hero, drawn as a BEAUTIFUL detailed retro-anime key visual with polished soft cel-and-gradient shading, fine confident linework, controlled glossy highlights and subtle halftone only inside the shadows (1990s-2000s premium OVA / vintage manga-cover rendering, NOT flat modern sticker-vector and NOT a rough manga sketch). Use a close HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS or chest-up BUST PORTRAIT that occupies roughly 65-78% of the canvas height; the face is large, crisp and instantly recognisable, the gaze faces the viewer or turns only slightly three-quarter. Keep hands outside the crop unless one simple iconic hand pose is essential. The torso must taper and END ABOVE THE BOTTOM EDGE rather than being cropped by it. A mandatory SIGNATURE-EFFECT CRADLE wraps the shoulders and lower bust in the character's canon power motif (flames, lightning, shadow ribbons, ice shards, wind, petals or energy); its asymmetric arcs, tongues and particles create the irregular lower die-cut contour, like the approved Tanjiro print finished by orange flames, with clean chroma still visible below and in both lower corners. Express aggressive/action temperament through the eyes, wind-swept hair, clothing and this contained effect — NEVER by shrinking the hero into a wide action scene. A HUGE stylised retro KATAKANA title wordmark dominates the upper area — chunky angular katakana with a bold outline and an inner highlight streak, slight italic energy — this fake 'magazine name' is the single largest graphic element. A tiny issue marker (a small kanji-plus-number tag like a year or number) sits beside the title. Scattered faux-Japanese cover typography surrounds the figure in clean reserved zones: two or three very short deadpan ENGLISH cover-lines stacked at the left, a bold VERTICAL kanji column with '!!' at the right, and a short bottom quote. A small cluster of circular and heart-shaped kanji charm-seal stamps (omamori style) sits in the lower area, and one large decorative kanji chop accents a lower corner. Typography floats as separate outlined graphic islands and never touches a canvas edge or crosses the eyes, nose or mouth. The artwork carries a clean vintage screen-print finish: light halftone dots in shadows and gently faded inks, but facial features stay sharp and premium. Slightly imperfect hand-assembled bootleg charm, never messy. NO real-world brand or band wordmark anywhere — the katakana title itself is the only wordmark.

styles.essence: A universal youth streetwear PRINT system built from the user's chosen directions 04, 08 and 05. The result must visibly look designed and separated by a human printmaker: only 3-5 broad flat ink masses, decisive hand-drawn contour, a few deliberate shadow shapes, quiet surfaces and slightly imperfect registration. No photorealism, CGI, 3D objects, HDR glow, glossy fantasy concept art, hyper-sharp microtexture, pores everywhere, ornate noise on every surface, generic epic armour, random sparks or swirling effect overload. Artwork must be fresh merchandise art, never a reconstruction of an existing album cover, publicity photo, official logo or supplied reference. Build an open irregular print directly on clean flat chroma with genuine gaps and a 6-8% moat. It is not a rectangular poster, page, card, magazine cover, photograph or sticker. Halftone is explicitly NOT part of this style. Never imitate white rectangular holes, broken masks, horizontal banding, stretched pixels or extraction artefacts.
styles.text_treatment: Use exactly one huge correctly spelled band-name wordmark across the upper zone, taking roughly 18-28% of the total composition height. Preserve the spelling supplied by the user, but create original letterforms matched to the musical direction: bevelled high-voltage block serif for hard rock, monumental high-contrast serif for classic/beat rock, angular forged display lettering for heavy metal, or another genre-specific custom treatment. For use on both black and white garments, lettering uses a saturated or metallic midtone fill plus a dark charcoal inner keyline and warm ivory/light-metal outer keyline; never pure-black-only or pure-white-only text.
styles.palette_rule: A disciplined 3-5 real-ink palette selected per assigned family and band mood: hard rock may use crimson, antique gold, charcoal and bone; classic/pop rock may use acid lime, cyan, magenta, violet and charcoal; heavy metal may use inferno red, ember orange, steel blue, charcoal and cold silver. Every colour should form a broad printable mass rather than a continuous gradient or glossy material. Choose green or blue chroma so no major artwork colour merges with the key field.

Новая самостоятельная композиция, не копия обложки альбома, концертной фотографии, официального маскота или приложенных референсов
Халфтон не использовать как основу стиля; допустимы чистые печатные цветовые блоки, плакатные тени, контролируемое зерно и живописные края
Анти-AI рендер: без фотореализма, CGI/3D, HDR-свечения, глянцевого concept art, микротекстуры на каждой поверхности, косметически идеальных лиц, перегруженной брони, случайных искр и вихрей эффектов

Запрещены белые прямоугольные дыры, рваные маски, горизонтальные полосы, растянутые пиксели и любые цифровые артефакты исходных файлов
Открытый фигурный принт на плоском хромакее с настоящими промежутками и чистым отступом 6-8%; не прямоугольный постер, страница, карточка, фото или стикер
Без общей белой подложки, cutline, общего ореола и замкнутой badge-формы вокруг всей композиции
Люди, руки и инструменты анатомически корректны; участники не дублируются, грифы и струны не ломаются
Палитра 3-6 сильных печатных цветов меняется вместе с композиционной семьёй и музыкальным направлением
Текст читается и на чёрной, и на белой футболке: цветная/металлическая среднетоновая заливка + тёмный внутренний и тёплый светлый внешний контур

styles.essence: A premium AUTOMOTIVE EDITORIAL STREETWEAR PRINT inspired by motorsport heritage posters and modern racing merch. The design is built around exactly ONE hero automobile, shown large in a crisp three-quarter front or dramatic low side view, with accurate proportions, recognizable body geometry, wheels, aero and period-correct colour identity. It may be a Formula car, endurance prototype, rally icon, touring car, supercar, JDM tuner or classic sports car; vary the category, era, country and visual language from design to design. The car must dominate 55-70% of the composition and may overlap the main wordmark to create depth. Pair it with MEANINGFUL subject-specific editorial data: one huge exact model/team/series wordmark, one short emotional racing statement, and only 2-4 compact factual accents chosen from race number, year, city/circuit, country flag colours, track-map line, class or engine-era notation. Every piece of copy must explain or celebrate the selected machine; never use random filler, fake sponsor soup, lorem ipsum or unrelated motivational text. Use only facts the art director is confident about; if an exact statistic is uncertain, use a truthful non-numeric phrase instead. Choose one of several composition families per design: (A) giant wordmark above with the car breaking through it; (B) car crossing a wide geometric speed bar with track map and number; (C) elegant heritage script plus circuit outline; (D) brutal condensed racing type with arrows and timing-grid marks; (E) minimalist museum-spec composition with model name, year and country. The result is a PRINT, not a rectangular photograph: no road scene, garage, grandstand, sky, white page, black page, poster sheet, card or full-bleed photo background. The car, type, track line, flag and geometric accents float as an open group directly on the uniform chroma field. Preserve open chroma gaps between elements and a clean 6-8% chroma moat at all four edges. Never put a white sticker outline, cutline, halo or shared backing around the car or the whole group. No driver portrait or human figure. Render the vehicle with polished high-detail automotive illustration realism, clean studio highlights and sharp tyre/body edges, while typography and geometric accents retain a controlled screen-print finish suitable for both black and white garments.
styles.text_treatment: Typography carries the meaning. Use exactly ONE huge primary wordmark: the selected car model, racing team, constructor, series or event name, spelled correctly and kept to one or two lines. Add ONE short 2-5 word statement that has a clear connection to the machine or racing culture, such as a heritage, speed, endurance, precision or city-at-night idea; never generic filler. Add only 2-4 small factual tokens: a race number, year, circuit/city, country, class or short technical-era notation. The primary wordmark may sit above/behind the car and be partially overlapped by it, but remains readable. Small data aligns to a clean editorial grid; optional arrows, timing ticks and a simple circuit-outline line support navigation and speed. Do not reproduce a dense wall of sponsor logos and do not invent pseudo-brand marks. All primary and supporting text uses a universal NEUTRAL DUAL-CONTRAST system: neutral silver/mid-grey or warm greige fill, a thin charcoal inner stroke AND a thin warm-ivory outer keyline at the same time, so every letter remains readable on both black and white shirts. Never use the car body colour or a saturated brand colour as the main lettering fill; those colours are allowed only in tiny marks. Never use pure black-only or pure white-only lettering. No text touches the canvas edge.
styles.palette_rule: Pull a disciplined 3-5 colour palette from the chosen car's authentic identity: one dominant body colour, deep charcoal contour/shadow, one or two period-correct accent colours and warm cream or mid-grey only as a local highlight. A small flat country flag may use its correct colours. No rainbow gradients, no unrelated neon wash, no all-white poster sheet and no solid black rectangular backdrop. Select green or blue chroma according to the car palette so the hero vehicle never merges with the key colour.
constraints: РОВНО ОДНА крупная машина без людей; правильные пропорции кузова, колёс и аэродинамики, узнаваемая геометрия выбранной модели/класса
Это фигурный принт на хромакее, НЕ прямоугольная фотография/постер/белый лист/чёрная карточка; чистый CHROMA MOAT 6-8% до всех краёв
Без общей белой sticker-обводки, cutline, ореола или подложки вокруг машины и группы элементов; внешний край машины напрямую встречается с хромакеем
Один огромный смысловой wordmark + одна короткая связанная с машиной фраза + только 2-4 компактных фактологических акцента
Текст пишется без ошибок и относится именно к выбранному автомобилю/гонке; никаких lorem ipsum, бессмысленных псевдослов и выдуманных точных характеристик
Композиции варьируются: wordmark-overlap / speed-bar / heritage-script+circuit / timing-grid / museum-spec; не повторять один шаблон во всей партии
Без стены случайных спонсорских логотипов и без поддельных логотипов; основной акцент — автомобиль, название, номер/трасса/страна
Машина занимает 55-70% композиции; все колёса и важные детали читаемы, ничего не обрезано краем

Весь текст читается и на чёрной, и на белой футболке: нейтральная серебристая/серая/greige заливка + двойной контрастный контур (charcoal inner stroke и warm-ivory outer keyline); цвет кузова только в мелких акцентах
Чистое плоское зелёное или синее хромакей-поле по всем краям под автоматическую вырезку

styles.essence: A premium PROFESSION TECHNICAL ARCHIVE APPAREL PRINT built from the authentic tools and visual language of exactly one profession. It is a designed editorial object study, not a person, workplace scene or generic set of icons. Use exactly FOUR profession-specific objects: one unmistakable hero object occupies 38-45% of the artwork and three unequal supporting objects establish depth and rhythm. Every object must be technically plausible and distinct, with accurate working geometry, brushed-metal highlights, engraved hatching, controlled screen-print grain and selected three-tone detail. Arrange them as an open asymmetric collage along the composition family assigned by the orchestrator: rising S-curve, falling diagonal, offset vertical archive, broken arc, cross-axis overlap or asymmetric cascade. The exact Russian profession title forms the central typographic spine. Add exactly four tiny numbered callouts 1, 2, 3 and 4, each once, with restrained leader lines, measurement ticks, registration marks and one partial technical-diagram fragment. These marks are decorative visual language, not extra copy. Preserve 20-30% real bare chroma between separated objects and a clean 7% chroma moat on every edge. No equal four-corner layout, clip-art collection, sticker sheet, badge, emblem, rectangular poster, page, card, catalogue grid, full workplace background or enclosing shape. A cropped working hand may appear only as a small supporting graphic fragment when essential, never as a portrait or full human figure. Lines must remain thick enough for garment printing and the entire composition must read from two metres.
styles.text_treatment: Use exactly ONE visible phrase: the profession title supplied by the user, converted to correctly spelled uppercase Cyrillic and written once only. Place it through the centre in a custom narrow industrial grotesk or precision technical display face; it may overlap a hero object by no more than 8%, but every letter stays reconstructable. No slogan, English translation, fake specification copy, pseudo-letters, dates, brand marks or repeated title. Use a mid-silver or warm-greige fill, a thin charcoal inner keyline and a warm-ivory outer keyline so the title remains usable on both black and white garments. Numbers 1, 2, 3 and 4 are the only other glyphs, tiny and each appearing exactly once beside its own callout.
styles.palette_rule: Use 3-5 controlled print inks: warm ivory, steel silver, deep charcoal and exactly one profession-appropriate accent selected per composition family (cyan, cobalt, amber, burgundy, orange or violet). Model metal through three broad tonal steps and engraved linework, not glossy 3D gradients. No rainbow palette, neon wash, photographic full colour, pure-white page or black rectangular backing. This style always renders on green chroma, therefore green, emerald, lime and olive are forbidden anywhere inside the artwork.
constraints: Ровно одна профессия; не персонаж, не франшиза, не портрет и не полноценная рабочая сцена
Ровно четыре достоверных предмета профессии: один hero-object 38-45% и три неравных вспомогательных, без дублей
Ровно четыре маленькие цифровые метки 1, 2, 3, 4 — каждая один раз — с тонкими выносками; никаких других цифр и псевдотекста
Единственная словесная надпись — точное русское название профессии ВЕРХНИМ РЕГИСТРОМ один раз; без слоганов, перевода и повторов
Композиционная ротация назначается кодом: S-дуга, падающая диагональ, смещённая вертикаль, незамкнутая дуга, перекрёстная ось, асимметричный каскад
Запрещена равная сетка из четырёх углов, клипарт, набор иконок/стикеров, badge, герб, постер, карточка, каталог и прямоугольная подложка
Предметная детализация премиальная: правильная геометрия, гравюрная штриховка, три крупных тона металла и локальное печатное зерно; без дешёвого CGI-глянца
20-30% чистого хромакея видно между элементами; чистый отступ 7% со всех сторон, никакой общей обводки, ореола или замкнутого фона
Линии, засечки и штриховка печатно-безопасной толщины, не исчезают после удаления GreenKey и читаются с двух метров
Только зелёный хромакей; в самом принте запрещены зелёный, изумрудный, лаймовый и оливковый цвета

styles.essence: RICH CITY NEO-CREST V2: create a dense, jewel-bright premium Russian city emblem for apparel, never a sparse dark badge or rectangular postcard. Treat the user's theme as exactly ONE real city. Build 7-10 large readable modules: one exact hero landmark at 30-40% of the artwork, exactly two separate supporting city anchors chosen only from accurate landmarks or truthful local symbols, one truthful geographic motif, one local transport or engineering motif and 2-4 broad decorative connectors such as rays, clouds, waves, foliage or architectural ornament. Never use more than three architectural landmarks and never merge them into a fantasy hybrid. Fill 86-92% of the inner silhouette with opaque coloured artwork; transparency belongs mainly outside the emblem, internal breathing gaps stay narrow and no empty chroma or near-black cavity may exceed 4-5% of the design. Use four overlapping depth planes: a bright partial sun, ring, sky or ornamental field; a secondary city layer; the hero ensemble; and a wide foreground connector leading into the title. Artwork occupies 74-78% of the height and the exact Russian city name occupies the lower 22-26%. Every large module receives a clear base, hard highlight and hard shadow under one top-left light source. Use thick print-safe contours, simplified but characteristic architectural detail and a three-stage outer edge (dark contour, narrow warm-ivory separator, final dark contour). The result is lavish, energetic and commercially polished, readable at thumbnail size and from two metres. Keep a clean 5-7% chroma moat around the outside. No giant lone bridge or tower swallowing the composition, large black hole, generic clock tower or skyscraper, empty sunburst, repeated symmetric trophy-badge template, random skyline, invented mountains, coat of arms, flag, official seal, tourist logo, rectangular page, full-bleed landscape, sticker cutline, shared white backing, photorealism, CGI gloss, soft gradients, tiny filigree, distress noise or text clutter.
styles.text_treatment: The exact city name supplied by the user is the single dominant wordmark, written exactly once in correctly spelled uppercase RUSSIAN CYRILLIC. Visible characters are limited to Russian letters А-Я and Ё, spaces and hyphens. Use one line whenever possible; a very long or compound city name may use two compact balanced lines without stretching or deforming glyphs. The plaque occupies 22-26% of the height and uses a custom condensed slab or monumental grotesk with a vivid MID-TONE city-colour fill, a narrow contrasting highlight stroke, a very thick near-black outer keyline, a warm-ivory separator and a short hard-edged coloured shadow. The letter fill is never white, near-white, black or near-black. By default there is no slogan and no other writing; add a second Russian line only when the operator explicitly supplies verified wording. Zero Latin letters, pseudo-letters, English translations, dates, numerals, repeated city names or microtext. Verify difficult Cyrillic glyphs such as Д, Л, И, Й, Б, У and Г and keep the title readable on both black and white garments.
styles.palette_rule: Use 8-9 deliberate print-ink colours selected for the city: near-black for outlines only, one deep coloured base, two bright related city hues, one contrasting cool hue, one hot red or orange accent, sunny yellow or metallic gold, warm ivory and optional clean white highlights. At least four saturated hues must appear as large unmistakable masses. Medium and bright colours cover at least 65% of the opaque artwork; near-black covers no more than 15% and all dark masses together no more than 25%. Hot accents cover roughly 15-20% and ivory or white highlights roughly 12-18%. Never use black as an interior background fill and never let grey, brown, navy or muted monochrome dominate. The city title uses one vivid mid-tone palette colour, not white or black. Every major object uses a base, one hard highlight and one deep coloured shadow with two- or three-step cel shading, never a muddy continuous gradient or HDR glow. Choose green chroma for blue/cyan artwork and blue chroma for green/malachite artwork, then forbid that chroma colour family inside the emblem. Keep internal colour masses opaque and the three-stage silhouette edge distinct on black and white fabric.
constraints: Ровно один реальный город; один главный ориентир, ровно два раздельных городских якоря из точных достопримечательностей или правдивых местных символов, один географический и один транспортный или инженерный мотив
Всего 7-10 крупных читаемых модулей, включая 2-4 широкие декоративные связки; не более трёх архитектурных объектов и никаких fantasy-гибридов
Внутренний силуэт заполнен цветным artwork на 86-92%; ни одной пустой chroma- или тёмной полости крупнее 4-5% площади
Название города — точная русская кириллица ВЕРХНИМ РЕГИСТРОМ один раз; перевод на английский, латинские буквы и псевдобуквы полностью запрещены
По умолчанию слогана и другого текста нет; вторая русская строка допустима только когда оператор явно передал проверенную формулировку
Ювелирно-яркая палитра 8-9 красок: минимум четыре насыщенных крупных цветовых массы; средние и светлые тона занимают не менее 65%
Near-black используется только для контуров и занимает не более 15%; все тёмные массы вместе не более 25%, чёрная внутренняя подложка запрещена
Четыре плана глубины, единый свет сверху слева, двух- или трёхступенчатые жёсткие блики и цветные тени; без фотореализма, CGI, мягких градиентов и HDR-свечения
Artwork занимает 74-78% высоты, плашка с названием 22-26%; главный объект не превышает 40% высоты и не поглощает композицию
Крупные контуры и просветы печатно-безопасной толщины; никаких тонких лесов тросов, микроскопических окон, шума, distressed-текстур и одиночных пикселей
Фигурный вертикальный принт на плоском хромакее с внешним отступом 5-7%; прозрачность преимущественно снаружи, не внутри композиции
Запрещены гигантский одинокий мост или башня, generic clock-tower/skyscraper, пустой sunburst и одинаковый симметричный trophy-badge шаблон
Не прямоугольный постер, открытка, страница, фото, стикер или общая белая подложка
Без герба, флага, официальной печати, государственного знака, бренда, туристического логотипа, выдуманных дат, цифр и дополнительного мелкого текста
Внешняя кромка по возможности трёхступенчатая: тёмный контур, узкий кремовый разделитель и финальный тёмный кант для чёрной и белой ткани

styles.essence: RUSSIAN STYLE SEMANTIC FUSION: preserve the user's exact subject, action, relationships and mood as the unmistakable hero of the print, then rebuild its visual logic through exactly ONE primary Russian decorative grammar and at most one quiet supporting grammar. Russian styling is structural, never a pasted souvenir icon: create a visible SEMANTIC BRIDGE in which the subject's own construction, motion or meaning becomes ornament — for example wheel spokes become rosettes, circuit traces become geometric embroidery, steam becomes a floral scroll, an animal silhouette carries the pattern, or an orbit becomes a lacquer-like ribbon. Choose exactly one composition family by meaning: NEOFOLK HERO for a person or dark-fantasy character; TRADITION IN MOTION for an action, sport or humorous modern activity; TEXTILE MANIFESTO for a short supplied phrase; ORNAMENTAL ANIMAL for an animal or bird; CONTEMPORARY FOLK PORTRAIT for a modern person, profession or hobby; ROOTS OF WORDS for a concise value statement; OBJECT ICON for food, transport, tools, technology and other objects. Keep one dominant readable silhouette at 50-70% of the artwork, 3-7 meaningful supporting motifs, controlled overlap and a rich focal cluster rather than a tiny lonely souvenir. Use one main surface language only: lacquer miniature, broad embroidery, carpet weave, vintage halftone poster, lubok-like print, enamel/filigree or flat decorative painting. The result is vivid, sophisticated, expensive-looking contemporary apparel illustration with authored rhythm, not tourist clip art, generic kawaii, photorealism, glossy 3D or a random pile of Russian clichés. Build an open irregular die-cut print directly on uniform chroma with real gaps and a clean 6-8% chroma moat. A self-contained woven rectangular textile patch with that moat is allowed only for TEXTILE MANIFESTO; it is never a full-bleed page. No shirt mockup, room, shared sticker backing or full-bleed scene.
styles.text_treatment: Typography is optional and must serve the subject. If the user supplied exact wording, reproduce that wording once, without translation or invention; otherwise prefer no text, except when an autonomous brief explicitly provides a verified short Russian phrase. Every visible word uses correctly spelled MODERN RUSSIAN CYRILLIC only: zero Latin letters, pseudo-Cyrillic, random historical letters, English translations, lorem ipsum or fake microcopy. Use 2-5 words and no more than three compact lines. For TEXTILE MANIFESTO, place the phrase in a balanced woven ornamental field with birds, flowers or rosettes supporting its meaning. For ROOTS OF WORDS, make branches, roots, berries or geometric stems physically continue the letterforms. In all other families, lettering is secondary and integrated as one plaque, arc or open typographic island; it never covers a face or the hero silhouette. Keep difficult glyphs such as Д, Л, И, Й, Б, У, Я and Ё legible on both black and white garments.
styles.palette_rule: Use one deliberate premium palette of 5-8 print inks, selected as a coherent family rather than a random rainbow. Approved directions include ruby + ultramarine + old gold + warm ivory; malachite + coral + cream + ink; cobalt + vermilion + ochre + linen; black-negative-space + crimson + warm gold + ivory; or dusty rose + deep teal + peach + navy. At least three saturated colours appear as clear medium or large masses; medium and bright tones cover at least 60% of the opaque artwork, while near-black is mainly contour/negative space and all dark masses stay below 30%. Simulated gold uses flat ochre, amber and a small warm-ivory highlight, never metallic gradients or cheap CGI shine. Choose green chroma when blue/cobalt dominates and blue chroma when green/malachite dominates, then forbid the selected chroma family inside the artwork. Texture stays inside colour shapes and never dirties the alpha edge.
constraints: Смысл запроса неприкосновенен: главный субъект, действие, отношения объектов и настроение нельзя заменять матрёшкой, медведем, кокошником или другим клише
Обязателен смысловой мост: минимум две конструктивные линии, движения или функции героя продолжаются в орнаменте; одного декоративного цветка рядом недостаточно
Ровно одна главная русская художественная грамматика и максимум одна вспомогательная; нельзя одновременно смешивать хохлому, гжель, мезенскую роспись, палех, ковёр, матрёшку и кокошник
Композиционная семья выбирается по типу запроса: герой / движение / текстильный манифест / орнаментальное животное / современный портрет / корни слова / предмет-икона
Один главный силуэт занимает 50-70% композиции, вокруг 3-7 смысловых мотивов; богатое наполнение организовано вокруг фокуса и читается с двух метров
